definitions.explanation: A roadside safety barrier made of horizontal metal pipes supported by posts. Common along sidewalks and at intersections to separate pedestrians from vehicles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ガードパイプ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a pipe guardrail along the sidewalk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ガードパイプ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{曲|ま}がった→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧。
examples.english: The pipe guardrail at the intersection was bent in an accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{車道|しゃどう}→車道：03066_shadou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飛|と}び{出|だ}さない→飛び出す：02374_tobidasu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、ガードパイプ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Pipe guardrails are installed so that children do not run out into the roadway.

notes:
From English "guard" + "pipe." A type of road barrier distinguished from the solid-beam ⟦ガードレール→ガードレール：06517_gaadoreeru⟧ by its construction from tubular pipe. Used mainly to protect pedestrians rather than to stop vehicles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ガードパイプ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to install a pipe guardrail
- ⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ガードパイプ: the pipe guardrail on the sidewalk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ガードレール→ガードレール：06517_gaadoreeru⟧: guardrail — a solid beam barrier, mainly to stop vehicles
- ⟦ガードケーブル→ガードケーブル：29910_gaadokeeburu⟧: cable barrier — uses tensioned cables instead of pipe or beam
